item.title: Kyoto Fusioneering starts work on key fusion power plant device
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Fusion power startups are turning to Kyoto Fusioneering to supply components for future power plants. The Japan-based startup just received a grant to build a part of the fuel system.

item.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.

item.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to fund the hunt for more novel materials to build more efficient chips.

item.title: This former notorious red-light district is now one of the world’s top AI hubs
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: More than 20 years ago, King's Cross was one of the seediest area's in London. Now it's sprouting something new.

item.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: Founder Ahmed Beshry describes the startup’s product as one “that could turn prompts, notes, documents, or research into a polished, editable presentation.”

item.title: Today’s the last day to get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: You put together the concept — from a founder mixer, an after-hours panel, a themed party, a morning run, whatever fits your goal — and the TechCrunch team helps put it in front of the attendees already in town for Disrupt.

item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is built around one question: How do you build an enduring company in the AI era? Our programming and speaker lineup reflect that.

item.title: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Hadrian is building automated factories to mass-produce parts for defense vehicles like submarines. It's backed by a long list of well-known investors.

item.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.

item.title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.

item.title: Trump’s DOJ gains oversight of OpenAI’s green-card employee sponsorships
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The DOJ alleged that OpenAI did not meaningful attempt to hire U.S. citizens before seeking permanent residence for Visa-holding employees.

item.title: How Lightspeed found its newest hire … via Instagram DM
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Lightspeed partners Josh Machiz and Claire Zau stopped by the Equity studio to talk about the strategies behind their growing social media presence and their podcast, Lightwork.

item.title: Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The serial entrepreneur joins the e-commerce company as CPO to lead its AI agents.

item.title: Meet the eight startups pitching at Startup Battlefield Australia
item.dc:creator: Isabelle Johannessen
item.description: The applications are in, and the TechCrunch Startup Battlefield team made their decisions!

item.title: Hark previews its browser use agent for completing tasks
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Hark claims that its browser use agent is faster and cheaper than competition.

item.title: Robinhood to list a fund that lets anyone back Y Combinator startups
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Robinhood's latest financial instrument intends to let any retail investor feel like they, too, can make money by backing Y Combinator startups.

item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Mitti Labs plans to expand beyond India and enter the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business.
